**Six people are killed and eight others are wounded in a [[mass shooting]] at a party in [[León, Guanajuato]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.infobae.com/america/agencias/2022/07/10/masacre-en-estado-mexicano-de-guanajuato-deja-al-menos-6-muertos-3/ (Infobae)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Uber Files]]
**Over 124,000 confidential documents are leaked from [[Uber]], showing efforts by Uber to lobby governments for preferential treatment. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-62057321 (BBC News)]
**Leaked documents reveal that [[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] went to "extraordinary lengths" to help Uber disrupt the French taxi industry, telling Uber's executives that he had brokered a "secret" deal with his [[French Left|socialist]] opponents in his cabinet. [https://www.theguardian.com/news/2022/jul/10/emmanuel-macron-secretly-aided-uber-lobbying-drive-france-leak-reveals (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Most of [[Argentina]] is placed on "yellow alert" by the National Meteorological Service due to high winds, hail and snowfall. [https://www.minutouno.com/sociedad/provincias/alerta-fuertes-vientos-tormentas-y-nevadas-este-domingo-18-cuales-son-n5482739 (M1)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Kiribati]] announces its withdrawal from the [[Pacific Islands Forum]], effective immediately, after President [[Taneti Maamau]] publishes a letter where he expresses four reasons for doing so, mainly due to the [[Secretary General of the Pacific Islands Forum Secretariat|Secretary-General]] of the Forum never having been from the [[Micronesia]]n region of the [[Pacific islands]]. [https://www.1news.co.nz/2022/07/10/exclusive-pacific-islands-forum-crisis-as-kiribati-withdraws/ (1news)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Soweto shooting]]; [[2022 Pietermaritzburg shooting]]
**In [[South Africa]], 15 people are killed in a mass shooting at a bar in [[Soweto]], [[Gauteng]]. Four more are killed at a tavern in [[Pietermaritzburg]], [[KwaZulu-Natal]]. Many others are wounded in both attacks. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-62111893 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Japanese House of Councillors election]]
**Japanese citizens go to the polls to elect members of the [[House of Councillors (Japan)|upper house]] of the [[National Diet]]. [https://asia.nikkei.com/Politics/Japan-election/Japan-election-voting-begins-in-shadow-of-Abe-assassination (Nikkei)]
**An exit poll by [[NHK]] projects that the ruling [[Liberal Democratic Party (Japan)|Liberal Democratic Party]] (LDP)-led coalition will retain its majority in the upper house, winning 76 of the chamber's 125 contested seats. The LDP is the party of former [[Prime Minister of Japan|prime minister]] [[Shinzo Abe]], who was [[Assassination of Shinzo Abe|assassinated]] two days prior while campaigning for the party's candidate for [[Nara at-large district|Nara]], [[Kei Satō (politician)|Kei Satō]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/7/10/japan-ruling-coalition-set-to-win-election-marred-by-abe-killing (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2022 Israeli legislative election]]
**[[Israeli politician]]s [[Benny Gantz]] and [[Gideon Saar]] form a [[political alliance]] to compete against [[Yair Lapid]] and [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/elections/2022-07-10/ty-article/.premium/gantz-saar-on-verge-of-joining-forces-in-upcoming-israeli-election/00000181-e7db-dc8d-a7c9-f7db0f8b0000 (''Haaretz'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 Wimbledon Championships]]
**[[Novak Djokovic]] of [[Serbia]] wins his seventh Wimbledon and overall 21st [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] title after defeating [[Nick Kyrgios]] of [[Australia]] in the [[2022 Wimbledon Championships – Men's singles|men's singles]] final, 4–6, 6–3, 6–4, 7–6 (7–3). [https://www.bbc.com/sport/tennis/62109725 (BBC Sport)]
